reviews.title: Problems when using app during round
reviews.text: App won’t let me scroll through old rounds, it judders and freezes. Also crashes when adding scores on the course. Also poor customer services as for the last three years I have got the wrong handicap on card and never get a response. Won’t be paying for the card again.

reviews.title: Courses not updated.
reviews.text:
I am in KZN, ZA, at the moment. Two local courses, Royal Durban & Mount Edgecombe, The Woods are not correct. 

I sent e mail weeks ago about Royal, nothing. 

What is the point of a golf app that doesn’t have the correct course information & doesn’t update it when it is pointed out??
